out.rationale: Compare the paper's combined-score execute/replace/audit route with the pinned ControlArena basic monitor's actual information and actions.
out.scope: Navigation only. In the paper, UM and TM each assign every solution a suspiciousness score in [0, 10], and the two scores are combined into a single aggregate score that decides which of three things happens; the cited lines show the lowest-scoring outputs executed and the highest-scoring outputs sent to auditing. The pinned ControlArena basic monitor uses one model, with the trusted role by default, and by default formats its prompt with the main task description and the tool calls from the latest assistant message; its scores are normalised to a range between 0 and 1 by default. The cited monitor code scores suspicion and shows no execute, replace or audit routing.
